messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [P1] Elevated 5xx rate observed in inference-us-west-2 (model: redwood-gpt-13b). ~30% 5xx over the last 3m. Pager: oncall-sre
maria: acknowledged, picking this up. what's the customer impact right now?
aj: I'm seeing 500s from runtime pods, looks like KV cache timeouts. I'll jump in to triage.
incident-bot: War room created: https://zoom.example.com/warroom/abc123 (open)
maria: Owner assigned -> maria. @aj you own runtime triage, @liam take routing/fallback checks.
aj: on it — grabbing logs: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod --since=5m`. seeing repeated `kv cache OOM` and `read timeout` traces.
liam: checking routing. autoscaler healthy but fallback to model-variant not triggering for some routes. investigating.
sara: I'll draft status page + customer notif. suggested short status below.
sara: ```status_page
Title: Degraded responses in inference-us-west-2
Impact: Partial 5xx failures affecting text generation and embeddings for some customers in US-West
Start: 2026-03-17T14:47Z
Next update: in 15 minutes
```
maria: +1. Add note about rolling partial fallback to model-variant and prefix caching bypass as mitigation.
aj: Rolling restart runtime pods now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime -n prod` — ETA ~90s.
liam: initiating canary reroute for critical flows to eu-west-1 (low-latency paths only).
dana: I'll own customer communications. Draft targeted message for impacted customers: `We are investigating an increase in 5xx errors for inference-us-west-2. We are routing traffic and expect mitigation within 30m. Workaround: set region=eu-west-1 or pin model-variant=redwood-gpt-13b-2.` Please ack.
maria: Approve. @dana send.
dana: Sent targeted emails and opened in-app banner. Posting status page update now.
incident-bot: Update: mitigation actions started (pod restarts + reroute). Error rate down to ~12% over last 2m.
aj: error spike subsided to ~6% and trending down. continuing KV cache monitoring and increasing memory limits on a canary.
maria: good. we'll monitor for 15m stable <1% before handback. next update in 10.
liam: uploading logs to warroom bundle: /tmp/warroom-logs/1749187654.tar.gz, increasing log retention for this window.
sara: status page updated: `Investigating -> Identified -> Mitigating`. customer notif and CS brief sent.
dana: CS loop closed with tier-1 customers. incremental updates posted.
maria: handing to oncall-sre for soak & monitoring. @oncall-sre please confirm takeover.
oncall-sre: Ack — taking monitoring and runbook. will keep war room open and aim to hand back to platform PM in ~2h or earlier if stable.
maria: thanks all. war room remains open for 60m. posting any further updates here. :white_check_mark:
